In my country, many student are choosing to study abroad after the high school, and I think this decision have both good and bad sides. When I came to Canada two years ago, I did not know how difficult it will be. The first semester I was very lonely because I could not understand the jokes of my classmates and I was afraid to speak in the class.

The biggest advantage of studying abroad is the language. You cannot learn English so fast in your home country, because you only use it in the classroom. Here I must use English for everything, for buy food, for talk with landlord, for go to the doctor. After one year my listening became much more better. Also I learned to be independent. In my home my mother was doing everything for me, but here I cook myself and pay the bills myself.

However, there is also problems. The cost is very high, the tuition for international student is three times more than for local student. My parents are paying for it and sometimes I feel guilty because I know it is big sacrifice for them. Another problem is the culture. Some things which are normal here are strange for me, for example to call the professor by his first name.

In conclusion, I think studying abroad is a good experience for a young person, but the student must be prepared for the difficulties. If I can give one advice, it is to make friends with local people as soon as possible, even if your English is not perfect. Nobody will laugh at you, most people are very kind.
